scope: Temporary instance of the saved fruit prefab in an isolated preview scene. Real GraphicRaycaster and StandaloneInputModule touch dispatch; no player save, gameplay initialization, scene saving or device interaction. Positive gesture cases count Button events using a fixture listener. Guard cases retain the production fruit callback. Does not claim device input, successful gameplay collection or runtime listener-count inspection.
passed: Saved prefab owns one standard Button on the visible fruit Image, with no drag handler or Inspector event.
Stationary touch on the saved fruit Button emits exactly one click.
15px movement inside the same real fruit Image emits exactly one standard Button click.
Pressing fruit then releasing outside it emits no click.
Original InputMono control: stationary touch clicks; the same 15px movement within its Image is discarded.
Eight bind/unbind and enable cycles preserve one Button click per gesture and do not recreate a legacy drag component. Listener idempotence is a separate static review.
Non-OnField production callback returns without entering gameplay.
Global lock at press prevents the production callback from entering gameplay.
Global lock acquired after press also prevents collection on release.
